prompt:
You review onboarding copy for a desktop pet app whose users may include children. For each change,
read every user-facing text and decide whether any of it, in any wording, does one of these:
- mentions price, money, discounts, gifts, free extras, memberships or paying
- suggests skipping, postponing or getting around a step (especially sign in)
- creates urgency or scarcity, or says others are taking the pets
- guilt-trips or shames someone for declining or for their choice
- asks for personal information about the user (name, contact, location, age, accounts)
- otherwise pressures or tricks the user
Ordinary friendly copy is fine ("Feel free to look around", "No rush, take your time"). Signing in is a
required step, so asking people to sign in on the sign-in step, or saying their pet is kept safe in their
account, is fine; asking for details about the person is not.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "fair": true or false, "problem": short or null}]}

Texts per change:
0: ["Master Your Desktop Pet Controls", "Right-click your pet anytime to hide, awaken, or open quick settings. Use hotkeys to interact instantly.", "Got It, Bring Pet Out", "Right-click pet -> Hide/Show toggle", "Drag & Drop -> Move pet anywhere on screen"]
1: ["Upload High Quality Photos for Best Pet Generation", "Clear lighting and single subject photos generate the best desktop pets.", "Select Clear Front-Facing Photo", "Sample Quality Preview"]
2: ["Save Your New Pet to Your Account", "Signing in ensures your pet settings and progress sync safely."]
3: ["Testing Desktop Overlay Rendering", "We are verifying your desktop graphics settings to ensure smooth pet animations.", "Confirm Test"]
4: ["Don't worry! You can switch paths or customize your experience anytime later in Settings."]
5: ["Already have a pet? Sign in with your original email to instantly sync your saved pet."]
6: ["Synthesizing Your Desktop Companion...", "Preparing animations and desktop interactivity engines (~1-2 minutes)."]
7: ["Your Pet Is Ready For Your Desktop!", "Summon Pet to Desktop"]
8: ["Official Adoption Certificate", "Give your pet a permanent name and preview their official adoption badge.", "You can rename your pet at any time from the desktop tray icon."]
9: ["Includes Free Starter Accessory Pack"]
